Reading the worker's framing: they label the daily-driver history rewrite as "required before public re-sync." I think that's overly cautious. Under Option 6b, the public mirror gets a fresh `git init` single commit — no shared object DB with the daily-driver. So daily-driver history dirty doesn't reach the public mirror. The JAR blobs only exist in the (already private) daily-driver's history, which has been the case since project inception.

Also: per [[rewrite-to-new-repo-pattern]] my mandate, if we DO rewrite, it has to be to a NEW private repo (e.g. `dstrader-docker-v2`) with owner rename-swap — NOT force-push existing main. That's significant ceremony (every commit SHA changes, every clone needs re-anchor).

The worker did good defensive work flagging it, but the SOP-R2-REMEDIATION.md + PR body call the rewrite "required" — that's stronger than the actual situation warrants. Want your call:
